records.text: The unidentified article author, quoted by Owens, reported that Jackson became registered agent in 2016 for Ferrost LLC, a Wyoming company linked to Ihor Kolomoisky, and that Kolomoisky was under investigation in the United States and Ukraine for allegedly laundering bank proceeds through shell companies. The company name is rendered inaccurately in the transcript and resolved by the existing source-specific entity evidence.

In 2016, Jackson (Cindy Jackson) became the registered agent for, for Roth LLC, a Wyoming company linked to a Ukrainian oligarch accused of, accused of stealing billions from one of Ukraine's largest banks... ... Igor Kolomoisky, a former politician, is under investigation in the United States and Ukraine for allegedly laundering bank proceeds through shell companies around the world.
